fact_bindings.body_span: Our 30 October 2026 host audit changed the review-platform classification from 1,663 of 18,893 target citation entries, 8.8% with a descriptive 95% Wilson interval of 8.4% to 9.2%, to 1,706 of the same 18,893 entries, 9.0% with an interval of 8.6% to 9.4%. The answers were captured on 22 and 23 September 2026. The [frozen and post-audit tables](/research/studies/who-ai-engines-cite/#what-changed-after-the-publisher-purpose-audit) preserve both readings. This is additional evidence about a classification, with no measured information-gain score or ranking effect.
fact_bindings.unit: target citation occurrences, fixed underlying entries

fact_bindings.body_span: Our [page-signal study](/research/studies/optimized-pages-in-ai-answers/) found llms.txt on 774 of 1,600 distinct final website origins hosting successfully captured target pages on 30 October 2026: 48.4%, with a descriptive 95% Wilson interval of 45.9% to 50.8%. An origin is the scheme, host and any port. Eighty-five of the 1,600 origin results were unknown. These were later file checks on the sources of answers captured on 22 and 23 September, not observations of an engine consuming the file or a test of a visibility effect.
fact_bindings.quote: target,all,all,llms.txt present,774,1600,48.375,45.9332,50.8246,distinct final origin,origins of successful complete HTML URLs
fact_bindings.unit: distinct final origins of successfully captured target URLs

fact_bindings.body_span: A worked example from our [published citation study](/research/studies/who-ai-engines-cite/) is: 39 of 2,095 eligible target answers captured on 22 and 23 September 2026 had empty supplied citation lists, 1.9%, with a descriptive 95% Wilson interval of 1.4% to 2.5%. The [answer-base table](/research/data/answer-citation-bases.csv) makes the unit and denominator recoverable. This sentence illustrates how to report our own count; it does not show that this writing format earns a citation, or that those answers used no underlying sources.
fact_bindings.unit: eligible target answers with an empty supplied citation list

fact_bindings.body_span: Our [published workbook reanalysis](/research/data/rovira-workbook-reanalysis.csv), checked on 30 October 2026, found that using all 25 query columns changed 456 of 1,000 stored median result-position summaries in the authors’ one-term, title-restricted Google Scholar workbook. The original observations were collected in May 2019. This is a finite calculation check, with no sampling interval; the 456 changed summaries are not 456 searches, papers accepted into Scholar or a measured inclusion tactic.
fact_bindings.unit: stored median result-position summaries, not queries or papers

fact_bindings.body_span: In our 30 October 2026 [static-page study](/research/studies/optimized-pages-in-ai-answers/), 4,179 of 4,420 successfully captured target URL records contained a canonical link: 94.5%, with a descriptive 95% Wilson interval of 93.8% to 95.2%. These URL records came from citations in answers captured on 22 and 23 September. The [published signal rows](/research/data/study1-url-classifications.csv) record the link’s presence, without establishing Google’s selected canonical or a citation benefit. Failed captures are outside this base.
fact_bindings.unit: distinct exact target URL records with successful complete HTML

fact_bindings.body_span: Our 30 October 2026 [page-signal study](/research/studies/optimized-pages-in-ai-answers/) recorded parseable, nonempty JSON-LD in 3,616 of 4,420 successfully captured target URL records: 81.8%, with a descriptive 95% Wilson interval of 80.6% to 82.9%. These were later page observations for citations in answers captured on 22 and 23 September. The [published signal rows](/research/data/study1-url-classifications.csv) establish that presence, not vocabulary validity, eligibility for a search feature or a citation effect.
fact_bindings.unit: distinct exact target URL records with successful complete HTML and parseable nonempty JSON-LD
